name: Zhihu Cloud Search
description: Search Zhihu content via official API. Supports in-site search and global web search across Zhihu's index.
description_zh: 通过知乎开放平台 API 搜索知乎站内内容和全网索引。

credentials.name: zhihu
credentials.description_en: Access secret for Zhihu Open Platform API
credentials.description_zh: 知乎开放平台的 access_secret（Bearer token）

directives.description: Search within Zhihu (articles and answers). Returns up to 10 results with title, snippet, authority level, and voteup count.
directives.description_zh: 知乎站内搜索（文章和回答），返回最多 10 条结果，含标题、摘要、权威等级和赞同数。

params_desc.query: Search keywords, required. Must not be empty.
params_desc.count: Number of results, optional. Default 10, max 10.

directives.description: Search across Zhihu's global web index. Supports advanced filter expressions and index selection. Returns up to 20 results.
directives.description_zh: 全网搜索 zhihu-share 索引库，支持高级筛选表达式和索引库选择。返回最多 20 条结果。

params_desc.query: Search keywords, required. Must not be empty.
params_desc.count: Number of results, optional. Default 10, max 20.
params_desc.JSON: Optional JSON object: {"filter": "...", "search_db": "realtime"}. filter: advanced expression (host==..., publish_time>=...). search_db: all(default)/realtime/static.
